title: Lay Down and Rest
notes:
Live theatre piece comprising partially improvised video design by Jack and partially improvised music written by me. We made it as a duo. 

My music consisted of guitar songs and ambient tracks, for which I played guitar, bass, synths, and programmed drums. One included a reading of Larkin's The Mower by Red Sullivan. Thanks Red! On another, I PaulXStretched It was described as 'beautiful' 'very good' and 'very moving'.
